name: XCC_BUDGET_DIST_ACCTS
description: This table stores budget amount per control budget, budget account and period.

columns.name: HEADER_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to  XCC_BUDGET_DIST_LINES.. Part of the primary key

columns.name: FUNDS_RELEASED_DATE
columns.description: Date on which funds are released.

columns.name: MASTER_PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Period name of source control budget.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: The period for which the budget is loaded

columns.name: AMOUNT
columns.description: Budget amount for specific control budget, account and period

columns.name: CONTROL_BUDGET_ID
columns.description: The control budget which is impacted by this distribution

columns.name: BUDGET_CCID
columns.description: The budget code comination id which is impacted by this distribution

columns.name: BUDGET_ACTION
columns.description: Indicates whether the distribution account row is for balance initialization or adjustment.

columns.name: DATA_SET_ID
columns.description: Data set identifier to be used by the budgetary control engine for budget adjustments.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_AMOUNT
columns.description: The original amount that the user entered in the interface.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PROCESSED_FOR_ESSBASE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates that balances have been transferred to the budget cube for this control budget and period name combination.Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
